name: Valpolicella

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, hot summer

keyfacts: Valpolicella is a DOC red wine from the province of Verona, authorized in 1968, blended mainly from Corvina and/or Corvinone at 45 to 95% and Rondinella at 5 to 30%.
Classico comes from the original zone around Negrar, Marano di Valpolicella, Fumane, Sant'Ambrogio di Valpolicella and San Pietro in Cariano, and Valpantena comes from the Valpantena valley.
Ripasso wine is passed over the pressed skins of Recioto or Amarone before barrel ageing, which gives it more body, flavor and alcohol.
Valpolicella Ripasso is a DOC of its own, and Amarone and Recioto della Valpolicella, made from partly dried grapes, are DOCGs of their own.

blurb.text: A red wine from Verona province in the Veneto. It became a DOC in 1968.
